meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 它把旧的 NanoClaw 和 Claude 记忆文件搬进共享的 memory/ 目录树,先不读内容地暂存、把符号链接单独隔离,再分类整理成记忆概念与长期指令,最后给出每个文件的源到目标报告。
howto.when: 当更新提示共享记忆出现破坏性变更,或某个分组仍留有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md 等遗留文件时运行;也可说“migrate memory”等关键词触发。

say.text: 帮我迁移这个分组的遗留记忆
say.note: 会先列出受影响分组并请你确认

say.text: 检查一下还有没有旧记忆文件没迁移
say.note: 会盘点遗留文件与链接状态

say.text: 看一下记忆迁移的源到目标报告
say.note: 会展示每个导入文件的处理结果

howto.what_en: It moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory into the shared memory tree and standing instructions: staging files unread, quarantining symlinks, then classifying them and reporting each source-to-destination outcome.
howto.when_en: Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md and similar leftovers; it also triggers on "migrate memory".

say_en.text: Migrate the legacy memory for this group.
say_en.note: Lists affected groups and asks for approval

say_en.text: Check whether any old memory files are left unmigrated.
Show me the source-to-destination migration report.
say_en.note: Shows the outcome for each import
